በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')

ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city')
ወበከየ: በከየ — and he wept (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, b-k-y)
በህየኒ: ህየ — there too (በ- + adverb ህየ + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
አእሩገ: አረጋዊ — elder, old man (plural አእሩግ (?); construct 'elders-of')

ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)

እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
እምቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — from the first, from the beginning (እም- + adj. as noun)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
ቀዲሙ: ቀዲም — formerly, before (adverb; ከመ ቀዲሙ 'as formerly')
አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')

ወወድቁ: ወድቀ — and they fell (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
በአፈ: አፍ — by the mouth of (በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
ኀጺን: ኀጺን — iron (noun; በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the edge of iron', i.e. the sword)
ወነሥእዋ: ነሥአ — and they took her (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs her', G)
ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of') · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (ወንሥኣ ለታቦተ ሕጉ 'and take the Ark of his law')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ወአእተውዋ: አእተወ — and they brought her in (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, caus. + -ዋ '3fs her') (?)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')

ወመከሩ: መከረ — and they took counsel (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, m-k-r)

ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ሀገራ: ሀገር — her city, her country (noun + -ኣ '3fs her', accusative)
ወሶበሰ: ሶበ — and if, and when (ወ- 'and' + conjunction + emphatic -ሰ)
ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)

ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')

ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55)
በርእሰ: ርእስ — on the top of (በ- + noun, construct 'head of')
አናጹት: አናጽ — unknown word (plural in -ት?), meaning not established (?)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ወአምሳለ: አምሳል — and likeness of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r)

ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)

ቤት: ቤት — house (noun) · construct 'house of' (ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory'; ሰብአ ቤት 'men of the house')

ወገነዩ: ገነየ — and they did homage, served (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
ዐውደ: ዐውድ — circle, cycle, round (noun; construct 'cycle of') · circle, court (?), in ዐውደ ቅሥት (?)

ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
በመዐት: መዐት — in wrath, in anger (በ- + noun)
ዕፀወ: ዕፅ — trees (plural ዕፀው, accusative) · construct 'planks, pieces of wood of' (ዕፀወ ለውሕ, ch. 56) (?)
ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
መሥዋዕተ: መሥዋዕት — offering, sacrifice (construct 'offering of') · also accusative 'a sacrifice' (ያዐርጉ መሥዋዕተ 'they offer a sacrifice')

ወተከሥተ: ተከሥተ — and were uncovered, revealed (ወ- + 3m passive perfect, k-š-t)
ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
ወቀብኦ: ቀብአ — and he anointed him (ወ- + G 3ms perf. with suffix 3ms -ኦ)

ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)

ትንእስ: ንእሰ — who is small, least (3fs imperfect, G; after እንተ relative)
በትር: በትር — staff, rod (noun); here a rod standing for a tribe
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
አእመሩ: አእመረ — they knew (3mpl perfect, a-stem, ʿ-m-r)
ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died'
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
ነሢኦታ: ነሥአ — taking her (infinitive ነሢኦት + -ኣ '3fs her' (written -ታ), accusative, n-ś-ʾ)
አርትዐ: አርትዐ — he set right, made straight (3ms perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be upright')
ወነግሠ: ነግሠ — and he reigned (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
በእገሪሁ: እግር — with his feet (በ- + plural እገር + -ሁ '3ms his')
በቅድሜሃ: ቅድሜ — before her (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- 'front' + -ሃ '3fs her')
በእደዊሁ: እድ — by his hands (በ- 'by' + plural noun + -ሁ 'his')
ትምጻእ: መጽአ — that you come (2ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
ወዝንቱሰ: ዝንቱ — and this one indeed (ወ- + m. demonstrative + emphatic -ሰ)
ዘትብል: ብህለ — what you say (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect ትብል, b-h-l)
ለብሔረ: ብሔር — to the land of (ለ- 'to, for' + construct) · upon (ለ- marking the place shone upon: አብርሀት ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'she shone upon the land of Ethiopia') · of the land of (ለ- marking the possessor: ሥርዐታ ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'the custom of the land of Ethiopia')

ትገብእ: ገብአ — she returns, would return (3fs imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ሠምረ: ሠምረ — he willed, was pleased (3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n)
ሥምረቱ: ሥምረት — good pleasure, favour (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', from ሠምረ)
ወለነሰ: ለ — and as for us (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + contrastive -ሰ)

ለጥበብ: ጥበብ — to wisdom, of wisdom (ለ- + noun; names the object or possessor already marked by a suffix)
ለፀሐይ: ፀሐይ — to the sun (ለ- + noun) · 'of the sun', owner named after a suffix (አምሳሊሃ ለፀሐይ 'the likeness of the sun')
ዘኢይበቊዕ: በቊዐ — which does not profit (ዘ- 'which' + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
ኢይበቊዕ: በቊዐ — it is of no use, does not avail (ኢ- negation + 3ms imperfect ይበቊዕ, G)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ለአብዳን: አብድ — to fools (ለ- + plural አብዳን of አብድ)
ጠቢብ: ጠቢብ — wise, a wise man (adjective used as noun)
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53)
